link_status_down: interface reported down by the poller (status event)
pop_unreachable: router not answering NMS polls (reachability event)
link_latency_high: one-hop latency >= 2x its trailing one-day EWMA and >= +1 ms
link_probe_fail: one-hop probe missing while interface counters are present
link_no_data: no telemetry at all for the link (collector gap or blanked)
svc_loss_sla: 15-minute mean end-to-end probe loss >= the service's SLA loss
svc_latency_sla: end-to-end latency >= the service's SLA latency
